This is my letter to you, who are still in waiting non-sleep:

32 years ago (before the turn) I came to this country to live a free and better life.

I also wanted to allow my children a free life.

Do you know what FREEDOM means? I don't think so.

In addition to the material advantages I hoped for here, FREEDOM was the most important goal for me.

As you may remember, there was no freedom of expression in the GDR, everyone who officially opposed the government was locked away. Likewise, there was no freedom to travel, we had to apply for a visa to be able to go on vacation in Russia or Bulgaria. It couldn't get any further away anyway. This visa was given only fellow citizens by state.

In the GDR there was a vaccination requirement.

I can't say everything was bad with us. For example, there were no unemployed, everyone had some job.

Yet something was missing... the FREEDOM.

I didn't miss much as a kid. As I got older already. On ′′ West TV ′′ I saw the beautiful clothes and the colorful and well-kept houses of the ′′ Wessis ".

In the movies I saw distant countries with other cultures.

I wondered why not see and experience all of this?

I also wanted to openly speak my mind if I don't like something. And just because a government, which consists of ONLY people, tells me things that seem unworthy to me, doesn't mean they are right. And then I want to be able to change something about it, also loudly and with all the other fellow human beings who agree with me.

We couldn't do all this in the GDR without being arrested and locked away.

I couldn't stand this state of being ′′ locked up ′′ any longer. So I submitted the exit application, after 4 years of waiting and monitoring, the day finally came into FREEDOM.

Then when I told the curious ′′ Wessis ′′ about the conditions in the GDR, some were horrified and the others laughed at me.

Your reactions:

′′ why did y'all like all this?"

′′ Why didn't you do anything about it?"

Why don't you just get on the streets and demonstrate?"

′′ We are free, we don't have such a thing. We can openly say what we think, we can travel wherever we want and over our bodies we decide for ourselves. If we don't want a vaccination, then that will be accepted."

my alarm bells rang as loud as they haven't been in a long time. My gut told me something was wrong. So I informed myself especially, even outside of ARD and ZDF.

And behold, more and more this big lie revealed itself.

Before I believe anyone unconditionally, I question this.

I ask you all to question everything!

Because that's the only way you can form your own opinion.

Do you know what rights you still have? And which ones were temporarily suspended indefinitely? I don't think so. Your opinion on this is :" oh what, well, it will all be okay, they can't do that......"

Don't run voluntarily, like stupid sheep chasing your slaughterhouse!

If you have so much power over you now, you won't give it out of your hand by choice!

I could still list so many new things here, but you know that yourself.
